title: Sum formula for power-row work
statement: For natural numbers $\ell,p$, let $M(\ell)$ denote the work of one binary modular multiplication, and define $A(\ell,e)=\ell+e(M(\ell)+1)$. Define $P_\ell(0)=0$ and $P_\ell(p+1)=P_\ell(p)+A(\ell,p+1)+\ell+1$. Then $P_\ell(p)=\sum_{q=0}^{p-1}(A(\ell,q+1)+\ell+1)$.
